parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1: Use the correct double-angle formula to obtain an equation in $\tan x$. A1: Obtain a correct fraction-free equation in $\tan x$ (condone missing $=0$ here). A1: Reduce correctly to $\tan^4x-2\tan^2x-3=0$; condone not mentioning $\tan x\ne0$. Answer-given working must be correct. Total 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1: Complete correct method to solve, obtaining a value of $\theta$ from $\tan^2(2\theta)=3$; must halve a value of $2\theta$. A1: Two of $\pi/6,\pi/3,2\pi/3,5\pi/6$. A1: The other two and no others in the interval; exact answers required. The solution $\theta=\pi/2$ from $\tan2\theta=0$ need not be seen. Total 3.
